name: Wild Hunter Dedication
prerequisites: expert in one of Nature, Stealth, or Survival
text:
You understand some of the wild hunt's techniques and can use them to form a primal bond with a trusted ally, much as members of the hunt do. You speak and understand Fey, gain darkvision, and gain the Additional Lore feat for Hunting Lore.

In addition, during your daily preparations, you can choose an ally as your hunting partner. They remain so until you choose a new hunting partner. You gain a wild link aura in a 60-foot emanation that has the aura and primal traits. While your hunting partner is in the emanation of your wild link aura, they can speak and understand Fey and gain darkvision.
